newsitem.title: UK: US arb for Euro VGO shuts,price slides in thin tra.
newsitem.headline: US arb for Euro VGO shuts,price slides in thin tra.

text.p: European VGO markets softened mid-week after falls in gasoline prices in the U.S. shut the arbitrage window, traders said.
Little low sulphur material was on offer. Some high sulphur material was believed on offer out of Scandinavia but no interest was shown.

"People are ignoring this market for now as its practically dead. They are looking not at the last decade of this month," one trader said. European public holidays this week worsened the sense of torpor, he added
Pricing was fairly notional, but traders said low sulphur had come off sharply in response to the U.S. mogas slide.
